title: epan+ftypes: Fix FT_PROTOCOL offset and length handling
description:
proto_tree_new_item did not actually set the protocol tvb based
off the start offset. Luckily it was (almost?) always called with
an offset of 0 by all dissectors.

Since proto_item_set_len / finfo_set_len allows the length to be
increased up to the length available in the data source tvb, the
protocol_tvb used for the FT_PROTOCOL has to be based off a subset
of the ds_tvb as well.

Fix #21306

AI-Assisted: no
